no_action.reason: No connected delay exceeded the four-minute benefit threshold, so changing operations would add work without enough recovery.

scenes.title: One delay, one connected rotation
scenes.narration: At eight thirty-six at Chicago O'Hare, a modeled baggage delay adds twelve minutes to U A fourteen fourteen's turnaround, putting U A twenty-six seventy-two at risk. GroundGraph must recover time without breaking policy.

scenes.title: Why GroundGraph decided now
scenes.narration: Why now? U A twenty-six seventy-two leaves at nine twenty-five, forty-nine minutes away, but its turnaround needs fifty-seven. The eight-minute gap opens a FalkorDB decision episode and locks all six specialists to one graph version.

scenes.title: Six specialists read one graph
scenes.narration: Six specialists read that state in parallel. Weather checks conditions. Flow checks runway capacity. Gate checks compatibility. Turnaround finds the delayed task chain. Policy confirms authority. Memory searches matching outcomes. The coordinator waits until all six versioned findings are stored.

scenes.title: Three options, one bounded model choice
scenes.narration: Now the tradeoff is visible. Turnaround recovery saves twelve minutes with four minutes of coordination. Flow balance saves twelve but spends runway flexibility. Gate recovery moves the rotation and saves six. The server validates and ranks all three before Qwen sees their identifiers. Qwen selects one allowlisted fit, and its choice is stored beside the shortlist.

scenes.title: Seven checks before one application
scenes.narration: The model cannot execute. The validator rereads graph version, target links, authority, knowledge freshness, benefit, execution freeze, and churn. Seven checks pass. One click writes the actions and modeled outcome to FalkorDB. Only now does projected delay move from thirty to eighteen minutes: twelve recovered under replay assumptions.

scenes.title: Continuous replanning also means no action
scenes.narration: At the next checkpoint, GroundGraph reads again. The projected benefit is now below the four-minute benefit threshold. The log records no action; model selection and application are skipped. Continuous replanning includes knowing when not to disturb a stable operation.

scenes.title: Memory and company knowledge stay connected
scenes.narration: The outcome becomes memory tied to event class, rotation, resources, and policy. A matching disruption may use it; unrelated weather cannot. Operations Brain follows the same graph to name the gate-recovery owner, responsible role, procedure, source section, and evidence path. Memory and company knowledge remain inspectable.

scenes.title: The same decision contract, another airport
scenes.narration: GroundGraph is not hard-coded to O'Hare. Atlanta loads a distinct FalkorDB graph with different flights, runways, weather, and evidence. Returning to O'Hare restores its applied decision.

scenes.title: Every intervention explained
scenes.narration: One shared graph. Six specialists. A bounded local model. Every intervention explained before it is applied.
